user_query: I'm organizing a themed costume party for Halloween. Can you suggest some unique and creative costume ideas? I also need recommendations for party decorations and spooky music playlists. Additionally, please provide some Halloween trivia and fun facts.

TaskList.description: Retrieve unique and creative Halloween costume ideas from a costume suggestion API.
Fetch recommendations for Halloween party decorations from a decoration ideas API.
Get suggestions for spooky music playlists from a music streaming API.
Collect Halloween trivia and fun facts from a trivia database API.
